raw_text: Kotlin Multiplatform Vulkan 1.4 wrapper; RAII handles, exceptions, NativePlacement allocations. Full API/extensions except deprecated/unsupported: render passes/framebuffers, custom allocators, raytracing. Dependencies: kotlinx-datetime, kotlinx-io, volk. Modules: `volk-kotlin`, `vulkan-kotlin`, `sample`. Desktop/mobile GPUs; Vulkan 1.3 minimum. Extensions: `VK_KHR_dynamic_rendering`, `VK_KHR_dynamic_rendering_local_read`, `VK_EXT_extended_dynamic_state2`, `VK_KHR_synchronization2`. The functions inside each class should be sorted by visibility (public then private), then lexicographically. `Device` class acts as factory for most classes needing `VkDevice`.
